notes:
v0.1.21 — terminal latency ~8x lower:
- Force shallow guest idle (processor.max_cstate=1 / intel_idle.max_cstate=0). Under WHPX a halted vCPU was woken with ~25ms jitter; keeping idle shallow drops terminal echo latency from ~25ms avg to ~3ms — with NO extra CPU usage (cores still halt, just not deep). Measured on real hardware.
- Applied automatically even if you keep an existing winmux.toml.
